# API endpoint reference

Read this file directly; no Swagger UI or site build is required.
See [API authentication and examples](api.md) and [all data models](api-models.md).
The YAML blocks preserve the complete authored operation contract, including nested request schemas, defaults, enums and response codes.
References beginning with `#/definitions/` name entries in the data-model reference.
These schemas document the checked-in API contract; consult feature guides for lifecycle and authorization requirements.

## Shared contract

```yaml
basePath: /api
consumes:
    - application/json
produces:
    - application/json
    - text/plain; charset=utf-8
security:
    - bearer: []
    - cookie: []
securityDefinitions:
    bearer:
        in: header
        name: Authorization
        type: apiKey
    cookie:
        in: header
        name: Cookie
        type: apiKey
```

## `/api/audit-webhook`

### GET

```yaml
responses:
    200:
        description: Safe configuration and current/next signing metadata
        schema:
            $ref: ./api-docs.yml#/definitions/AuditWebhookConfiguration
    403:
        description: Administrator permission required
    404:
        description: Audit webhook export is unavailable in this edition
summary: Read the non-secret audit webhook configuration and signing status
tags:
    - signed-webhook
```

### PUT

```yaml
parameters:
    - in: body
      name: configuration
      required: true
      schema:
        $ref: '#/definitions/AuditWebhookConfigurationInput'
responses:
    200:
        description: Updated non-secret configuration
        schema:
            $ref: ./api-docs.yml#/definitions/AuditWebhookConfiguration
    400:
        description: Invalid endpoint, credential, unknown field, or body
    403:
        description: Administrator permission required
    404:
        description: Audit webhook export is unavailable in this edition
summary: Configure the HTTPS audit receiver and optional legacy Bearer credential
tags:
    - signed-webhook
```

## `/api/audit-webhook/deliveries`

### GET

```yaml
parameters:
    - default: 25
      in: query
      maximum: 100
      minimum: 1
      name: count
      required: false
      type: integer
    - default: 0
      in: query
      minimum: 0
      name: offset
      required: false
      type: integer
responses:
    200:
        description: Bounded delivery history
        schema:
            items:
                $ref: ./api-docs.yml#/definitions/AuditWebhookDelivery
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
    400:
        description: Invalid pagination
    403:
        description: Administrator permission required
summary: List newest audit webhook deliveries without payloads or signing material
tags:
    - signed-webhook
```

## `/api/global-credentials`

### GET

```yaml
description: Requires global audit or any global credential metadata, rotation, or grant permission. Values and external reference coordinates are never returned.
parameters:
    - default: 25
      in: query
      maximum: 100
      minimum: 1
      name: count
      type: integer
    - default: 0
      in: query
      minimum: 0
      name: offset
      type: integer
responses:
    200:
        description: Bounded value-free summaries
        schema:
            items:
                $ref: ./api-docs.yml#/definitions/GlobalCredentialSummary
            type: array
    400:
        description: Invalid or ambiguous pagination
    403:
        description: Missing global credential permission
summary: List global credential summaries
tags:
    - global-credential
```

### POST

```yaml
description: Requires both global.credentials.metadata.manage and global.credentials.rotate. Material is write-only.
parameters:
    - in: body
      name: Credential
      required: true
      schema:
        $ref: '#/definitions/GlobalCredentialCreateRequest'
responses:
    201:
        description: Value-free credential summary
        schema:
            $ref: ./api-docs.yml#/definitions/GlobalCredentialSummary
    400:
        description: Invalid input
    403:
        description: Either required permission is missing
    503:
        description: Local material encryption is unavailable
summary: Create a global credential and its first immutable version
tags:
    - global-credential
```

## `/api/global-credentials/{credential_id}`

Parameters shared by all methods at this path:

```yaml
- $ref: '#/parameters/credential_id'
```

### GET

```yaml
description: Requires global.credentials.metadata.manage. Local material and ciphertext are always omitted.
responses:
    200:
        description: Detailed value-free metadata
        schema:
            $ref: ./api-docs.yml#/definitions/GlobalCredentialDetail
    403:
        description: Missing metadata-management permission
    404:
        description: Credential not found
summary: Get detailed global credential metadata
tags:
    - global-credential
```

### PUT

```yaml
description: Requires global.credentials.metadata.manage. Material cannot be included.
parameters:
    - in: body
      name: Metadata
      required: true
      schema:
        $ref: '#/definitions/GlobalCredentialMetadataUpdateRequest'
responses:
    200:
        description: Updated value-free summary
        schema:
            $ref: ./api-docs.yml#/definitions/GlobalCredentialSummary
    400:
        description: Invalid input
    403:
        description: Missing metadata-management permission
    404:
        description: Credential not found
    409:
        description: Stale revision
summary: Update global credential display metadata
tags:
```

## `/api/project/{project_id}/tasks`

Parameters shared by all methods at this path:

```yaml
- $ref: '#/parameters/project_id'
```

### GET

```yaml

    200:
        description: Array of tasks in chronological order
        schema:
            items:
                $ref: '#/definitions/Task'
            type: array
summary: Get Tasks related to current project
tags:
    - task
```

### POST

```yaml
parameters:
    - description: Fingerprint returned by the reviewed task preflight
      in: header
      name: X-Semaphore-Preflight-Fingerprint
      required: false
      type: string
    - description: Opaque short-lived token returned by the reviewed task preflight
      in: header
      name: X-Semaphore-Preflight-Token
      required: false
      type: string
    - description: |
        Either template_id or template_name must be given. When both are given, template_id is used.
      in: body
      name: task
      required: true
      schema:
        properties:
            arguments:
                type: string
            debug:
                type: boolean
            diff:
                type: boolean
            dry_run:
                type: boolean
            environment:
                type: string
            git_branch:
                type: string
            inventory_id:
                type: integer
            limit:
                type: string
            message:
                type: string
            playbook:
                type: string
            ssh_keys:
                description: |
                    Additional SSH key references and their exact hosts. On templates and tasks, null inherits the parent selection and an empty array explicitly replaces it. Project always_ssh_keys are added in either case. Task overrides are restricted to users who can manage project resources and rejected for cross-project execution. Key IDs must identify project-owned SSH credentials. The complete encoded selection is bounded to 64 KiB. New projects accept only null or empty lists; assign bindings after creating their SSH credentials. Host lists are optional below five distinct task-agent identities, counting Repository and Inventory keys; runtime host routing is required from five. Explicit host lists apply at every size. This configures client selection, not an enforcement boundary against task-controlled SSH clients.
                example: []
                items:
                    $ref: '#/definitions/TaskSSHKeyBinding'
                maxItems: 64
                type: array
                x-nullable: true
            template_id:
                type: integer
            template_name:
                example: Build website
                type: string
        type: object
responses:
    201:
        description: Task queued
        schema:
            $ref: '#/definitions/Task'
    409:
        description: Reviewed plan is stale, expired, invalid, or currently denied
        schema:
            $ref: '#/definitions/ExecutionPreflightStale'
summary: Starts a job
tags:
    - task
```


<a id="endpoint-122"></a>

## `/api/project/{project_id}/workflows/{workflow_id}/runs/{run_id}/file-artifacts/{artifact_id}/content`

Parameters shared by all methods at this path:

```yaml
- $ref: '#/parameters/project_id'
- $ref: '#/parameters/workflow_id'
- $ref: '#/parameters/run_id'
- $ref: '#/parameters/artifact_id'
```

### GET

```yaml
parameters:
    - description: Byte ranges are not supported; any non-empty value returns 416.
      in: header
      name: Range
      required: false
      type: string
produces:
    - application/octet-stream
responses:
    200:
        description: Exact immutable file bytes
        headers:
            Accept-Ranges:
                description: Always none
                type: string
            Cache-Control:
                description: Always private, no-store
                type: string
            Content-Disposition:
                description: Safe attachment filename generated by the server
                type: string
            Content-Length:
                description: Immutable artifact size
                format: int64
                type: integer
            X-Checksum-SHA256:
                description: Lowercase SHA-256 checksum of the streamed bytes
                type: string
            X-Content-Type-Options:
                description: Always nosniff
                type: string
        schema:
            format: binary
            type: string
    404:
        description: Artifact is missing, hidden, partial, failed, expired, or deleted
    416:
        description: Range requests are unsupported
summary: Stream an authorized available file artifact
tags:
    - workflow
```

### PUT

```yaml
consumes:
    - application/octet-stream
parameters:
    - in: query
      minimum: 1
      name: revision
      required: true
      type: integer
      x-example: 1
    - format: int64
      in: query
      minimum: 0
      name: offset
      required: true
      type: integer
      x-example: 0
    - in: body
      name: chunk
      required: true
      schema:
        format: binary
        maxLength: 1048576
        type: string
responses:
    200:
        description: Updated staging metadata and next revision
        schema:
            $ref: ./api-docs.yml#/definitions/WorkflowFileArtifact
    400:
        description: Invalid revision, offset, empty body, or task-attempt binding
    404:
        description: Artifact or producer is hidden or unavailable
    409:
        description: Revision, offset, state, or task-attempt conflict
    413:
        description: Chunk exceeds 1 MiB
summary: Append one exact-offset bounded chunk to a staging artifact
tags:
    - workflow
```

### HEAD

```yaml
responses:
    200:
        description: The same safe content headers as GET, without a response body
    404:
        description: Artifact is missing, hidden, partial, failed, expired, or deleted
    416:
        description: Range requests are unsupported
summary: Authorize and inspect an available file artifact without streaming content
tags:
    - workflow
```

### POST

```yaml
consumes:
    - application/json
description: |
    Stores one option for the authenticated user. The `key` is an allowlisted suffix (e.g. `nav.unpinnedItems`); the server prepends the user namespace, so a request can never read or write another user's options or a global option. Unknown keys are rejected with 400.
parameters:
    - in: body
      name: body
      required: true
      schema:
        $ref: '#/definitions/Option'
responses:
    200:
        description: Stored option
        schema:
            $ref: '#/definitions/Option'

summary: Stores a single option for the current user
```


### PUT

```yaml
description: Scope, revision, actor, and database timestamp are derived by the server. A tighter global policy cannot invalidate a current project policy.
parameters:
    - in: body
      name: retention
      required: true
      schema:
        $ref: '#/definitions/WorkflowArtifactRetentionUpdate'
responses:
    200:
        description: Published global policy and effective limits
        schema:
            $ref: ./api-docs.yml#/definitions/WorkflowArtifactRetentionState
    400:
        description: Invalid or unexpected input
    403:
        description: Missing global system-management permission
    404:
        description: Enhanced retention governance is unavailable
    409:

    413:
        description: Request exceeds 16 KiB
summary: Publish a new global workflow file artifact retention revision

    - workflow
```

## `/api/workflow-triggers/{project_id}/{workflow_id}/{trigger_id}/webhook`

Parameters shared by all methods at this path:

```yaml
- $ref: '#/parameters/project_id'
- $ref: '#/parameters/workflow_id'
- $ref: '#/parameters/trigger_id'
```

### POST

```yaml
description: The HMAC binds POST, the exact raw path and query, event ID, Unix timestamp, key ID, and exact body bytes using the semaphore.webhook.v1 binary framing. Every protocol header is required exactly once. Bearer fallback is rejected.
parameters:
    - enum:
        - semaphore.webhook.v1
      in: header
      name: X-Semaphore-Webhook-Version
      required: true
      type: string
    - in: header
      maxLength: 128
      minLength: 16
      name: X-Semaphore-Event-ID
      required: true
      type: string
    - description: Canonical Unix seconds within five minutes of server UTC time.
      in: header
      name: X-Semaphore-Timestamp
      required: true
      type: string
    - in: header
      name: X-Semaphore-Key-ID
      pattern: ^swhkid_[-_A-Za-z0-9]+$
      required: true
      type: string
    - in: header
      name: X-Semaphore-Signature
      pattern: ^v1=[0-9a-f]{64}$
      required: true
      type: string
    - in: body
      name: payload
      required: true
      schema:
        $ref: '#/definitions/WorkflowTriggerInvocationInput'
responses:
    201:
        description: Event claimed durably and workflow start recorded
        schema:
            $ref: ./api-docs.yml#/definitions/WorkflowTriggerFireResult
    401:
        description: Authentication, signature, key, timestamp, trigger state, or authorization rejected without detail
    409:
        description: Event ID was already claimed; no second workflow is started
    413:
        description: Body exceeds 256 KiB
security: []
summary: Start a workflow from an authenticated, fresh, replay-protected webhook
tags:
    - signed-webhook
```
